# xCal
> xCal is an AI-powered scheduling assistant that helps users book meetings through natural language and conversational workflows.

xCal provides calendar scheduling, booking links, team availability, routing, and integrations for individuals and organizations. Its site includes product pages, documentation, API references, integrations, and company resources.

## Product
- [Home](https://xcal.tv/): Overview of xCal’s AI scheduling platform and core booking capabilities.
- [Features](https://xcal.tv/features): Summary of scheduling, automation, and calendar management functionality.
- [AI Scheduling Assistant](https://xcal.tv/ai-scheduling-assistant): Product page for conversational AI-based meeting scheduling.
- [Booking Links](https://xcal.tv/booking-links): Information about shareable scheduling pages for individuals and teams.
- [Team Scheduling](https://xcal.tv/team-scheduling): Overview of collaborative scheduling and team availability coordination.
- [Routing Forms](https://xcal.tv/routing-forms): Details on qualifying and routing invitees to the right meeting type.

## Documentation
- [Docs Home](https://docs.xcal.tv/): Main documentation portal for setup, usage, and platform capabilities.
- [Getting Started](https://docs.xcal.tv/getting-started): Introductory guide for setting up xCal and creating scheduling workflows.
- [User Guide](https://docs.xcal.tv/user-guide): Documentation for everyday scheduling, booking, and calendar management tasks.
- [Admin Guide](https://docs.xcal.tv/admin-guide): Guidance for workspace administration, permissions, and organizational settings.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.xcal.tv/troubleshooting): Help for resolving common setup, sync, and scheduling issues.

## API & Developers
- [Developer Portal](https://docs.xcal.tv/developers): Entry point for developers building with xCal APIs and integrations.
- [API Reference](https://docs.xcal.tv/api-reference): Reference documentation for xCal endpoints, requests, and responses.
- [Authentication](https://docs.xcal.tv/developers/authentication): Details on API authentication and secure access patterns.
- [Webhooks](https://docs.xcal.tv/developers/webhooks): Information on subscribing to scheduling events and webhook payloads.
- [Rate Limits](https://docs.xcal.tv/developers/rate-limits): Usage limits and best practices for reliable API consumption.

## Integrations
- [Integrations Overview](https://xcal.tv/integrations): Directory of supported calendar, conferencing, and workflow integrations.
- [Google Calendar](https://xcal.tv/integrations/google-calendar): Integration details for syncing availability and events with Google Calendar.
- [Microsoft Outlook](https://xcal.tv/integrations/outlook): Information on connecting Outlook calendars for scheduling and event management.
- [Zoom](https://xcal.tv/integrations/zoom): Details on automatically creating Zoom meetings for booked events.
- [Slack](https://xcal.tv/integrations/slack): Overview of Slack notifications and workflow integration options.
- [Zapier](https://xcal.tv/integrations/zapier): Automation integration for connecting xCal with external apps and processes.

## Guides
- [Guides Home](https://docs.xcal.tv/guides): Collection of practical tutorials and workflow examples for xCal users.
- [Set Up Your First Booking Page](https://docs.xcal.tv/guides/first-booking-page): Step-by-step guide to creating and publishing a booking page.
- [Connect Your Calendar](https://docs.xcal.tv/guides/connect-calendar): Instructions for linking external calendars and syncing availability.
- [Create Team Scheduling Workflows](https://docs.xcal.tv/guides/team-workflows): Tutorial for configuring round-robin and pooled team scheduling.
- [Use Routing Forms](https://docs.xcal.tv/guides/routing-forms): Guide to building forms that qualify and direct meeting requests.
- [Embed xCal on Your Website](https://docs.xcal.tv/guides/embed): Instructions for embedding booking experiences into external sites.

## SDKs & Tools
- [SDKs Overview](https://docs.xcal.tv/sdks): Overview of available client libraries and developer tooling.
- [JavaScript SDK](https://docs.xcal.tv/sdks/javascript): Documentation for integrating xCal using JavaScript applications.

- [Python SDK](https://docs.xcal.tv/sdks/python): Python library documentation for interacting with xCal services.
- [Postman Collection](https://docs.xcal.tv/tools/postman): Ready-made API requests for testing and exploring xCal endpoints.
